Kill the assassins. Use Protect from Ranged. If one says 'Now!' they will fire a hard-hitting ranged attack if not prayed against. Straight after, the other will say 'Nothing personal, adventurer', they will teleport to you and dragon dagger spec you. Protect from Melee straight after the strong ranged attack hits to be safe.

Defeat Surok. Read the sidebar for more details.

Defeat Surok. You must use magic to hurt him. You cannot use powered staves. He has three special attacks: 1. A henchman appears. Cast 'Weaken' on a 'Strong' one, or 'Bind' on a 'Agile' one. If they reach you you will take 40+ damage. 2. Surok throws an explosive orb. You must telegrab it, and then alch it, or you will take 45+ damage. 3. Surok casts a surge attack. Cast the opposite elemental spell back. Cast Air for Earth, Water for Fire, Earth for Air, Fire for Water.
Use the teleorb on Surok Magis.

Head through the now open entrance to the south and approach the Stone of Jas, ready to fight.

Fight the Balance Elemental. You need all 3 combat styles to defeat it. If you pray incorrectly against the first new style of attack, your stats will be majorly drained. As its health gets lower, it starts to attack faster.  When it has a fire head, it attacks with ranged. When it has an air head, it attacks with melee. When it has a water head, it attacks with magic.
